answer: Think of each identity as a quartz crystal: striking alone, worthless when mass-produced. My mechanism traces every agent stake back to its funding root on-chain and caps the total standing of all identities sharing one root at a single identity worth, so cloning adds nothing. A ripple of new accounts from the same wallet therefore earns no extra influence, and laundering the trail through mixers only raises the required bond. The onyx ledger keeps every root public and auditable, so attackers must either pay full price per identity or stay visible and capped.
